newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: profile of the winner of the World Cup Finals women's giant
World Cup wins: 12 -- 9 giant slalom, 2 Super-G, 1 slalom.
This season - 5 victories. 4 slaloms: 2 at Zwiesel, Cortina
D'Ampezzo, World Cup Finals, Vail. 1 slalom at Semmering.
Other feats: Won World Cup giant slalom championship. Was
double gold medal winner at Sestriere world championships
winning slalom and giant slalom. Giant slalom world champion
in 1996. Olympic Super-G champion in 1992. Olympic giant
